candidate: CAUSAL: alternating causal estimating-equation recurrent feature learner; novelty unverified
chronology: Cryptographic commitment to the already written full protocol before all new candidate fits. Preliminary initial-training diagnostics only have been computed.

evaluation.target: original price net changes, all20 horizons trained
evaluation.primary: equal mean of six year/horizon MSE-to-RW ratios; mean seed loss separate from prediction ensemble
evaluation.scope: repeatedly exposed development, not independent confirmation

model.encoder: full-prefix GRU(1,16), zero initial state, causal outputs at each origin
model.features: 8 learned tanh features using hidden state and three ordinary reference-state coordinates
model.reference: same31-member causal reference, W240, no historical forecast overwrite
model.kernel: Omega_h(i,j)=max(0,h-|i-j|)/h; C=.5I+.5Omega; P=C^-1 normalized to trace n
model.head: B_h=(G^T U_h G/n + gamma G^T G/n + alpha I)^-1 G^T U_h E_h/n
model.encoder_update: hold B fixed; derivative of predictions paired with stop_gradient(U*(prediction-target)+gamma*prediction); do not differentiate the nonsymmetric profiled solution
model.limits: GLS/GMM/IV/analytic heads are not new. Pointwise valid moments under a correctly represented full-history conditional mean do not guarantee finite-sample unbiasedness, neural convergence or future risk.

controls: ID analytic ridge, symmetric GLS, support-permuted then causalized precision, fixed random recurrent features; fresh window FULL/GRU, RW/MLE/drift/Ridge/tree and mature/fixed reference-GRU combinations
preliminary_gate: Exact known-null population score at n256 h1/5/20: causal and ID numerators zero; retain symmetric GLS counterexample. 32 fixed Gaussian null and AR(.5) replicated scalar-estimator controls,300 fitting+300 independent check, require null candidate relative MSE<=1.05. No market data or neural scores in this gate.
development_gate: CAUSAL beats ID/SYMMETRIC/SHUFFLED mean-seed scores by>=1% each, ID paired wins>=3/4, beats FROZEN, RW improvement>=2%, beats best fresh noncandidate pool>=1%, same-four-prediction ensemble beats corresponding pool, no year>5% worse thanRW. Thresholds are project rules, not journal standards.
reading: Actual primary HTML reading of arXiv2402.01000v3 intro and sections3-4; publisher summaries for Lai/Small2007 and Pepe/Anderson1994. Current2026 article abstracts are leads only. No full-text or original-code reproduction inflation.
finish: Preserve all results and failures; push complete source/tests/protocol/numeric results/logs/audit on this branch. Do not merge main, change visibility, publish unapproved price suffix or third-party full texts. If gate fails, stop without rescue parameters or new historical periods.
